conditions: Valid while FT-2002 is in service and FAL-2002 is not shelved or suppressed.
rationale: SIF-200-01 trips at 120 m3/h on FT-2001A/B/C. FT-2002 is the BPCS vortex meter on the same line, a separate transmitter on a separate system; FAL-2002 at 160 m3/h annunciates before the trip point.

conditions: Valid while PT-2014 is in service and PAL-2014 is not shelved.
rationale: SIF-200-02 trips at 0.35 barg on PT-2010A/B. PT-2014 is the BPCS monitoring transmitter on the burner header with its own tapping; PAL-2014 is rationalised at 0.6 barg, above the trip point.

SIF-200-03 trips at 2.8 barg on PT-2011 (1oo1). The only high pressure alarm, PAH-2012, shares PT-2012 with the PIC-2012 loop whose failure is the demand, so it is not a compensating measure. An independent PAH on PT-2014 is proposed under MOC-2026-041 and does not exist yet.

conditions: Valid while TT-2021 is in service and TAH-2021 is not shelved.
rationale: SIF-200-04 trips at 345 degC on TT-2020A/B/C. TAH-2021 at 330 degC is taken from the BPCS control transmitter TT-2021, independent of the SIS transmitters.

conditions: Valid while TT-2022 is in service and TAH-2022 is not shelved.
rationale: Tube skin temperature responds to the same over-firing; a second, slower indication behind TAH-2021.

conditions: Valid while LT-2031 is in service and LAH-2031 is enabled and not shelved.
rationale: SIF-200-05 trips at 900 mm on LT-2030A/B. LT-2031 is the BPCS DP transmitter on the same drum; LAH-2031 at 720 mm annunciates before the trip point.
